㡬: jī — slight, subtle; gently (the edition's form of 幾; 事父母幾諫 'remonstrate gently')
三: sān — three; (before a verb) three times, on three counts
三歸: sān guī — the 'Sangui': a terrace built by Guan Zhong (Zhu Xi: 三歸臺名); others take it as 'three wives' or 'three estates'
下: xià — below; to go down, to come down (from the hall)
且: qiě — and moreover, besides (adds a further result)
世: shì — an age, a generation; in 十世, the ages of successive dynasties (Zhu Xi: 王者易姓受命為一世)
中: zhōng — within, in (禄在其中 'the salary lies within it'); read zhòng 'to hit the mark'
主: zhǔ — host, master; to take as the chief thing
久: jiǔ — long, for a long time
之: zhī — (1) object pronoun: it, him, them; (2) genitive 'of', ''s'; (3) between subject and verb, turns a clause into a noun; (4) marks a fronted object
乎: hū — (1) final question particle; (2) preposition 'from, than, at' (= 於)
乘: shèng — chariot (a four-horse war chariot, counted as a measure of a state's size); read chéng 'to ride'
也: yě — final particle of assertion; after a topic, a pause: 'as for…'. Not modern 'also'.
予: yú — I, me (= 余); read yǔ 'to give'
争: zhēng — to contend, to vie (the edition's form of 爭)
二三子: èr sān zǐ — you, my friends: a master addressing his disciples or a speaker his companions (literally 'two or three sirs')
于: yú — on, to, at (= 於); in 友于兄弟 'befriend one's brothers'
亡: wáng — to perish, to be lost; read wú = 無 'not to have, to lack' (3.5)
交: jiāo — to associate with, to deal with
亦: yì — also, too; indeed (in 不亦…乎 'is it not indeed…?')
人: rén — others (as against oneself); a person, people
仁: rén — humaneness: the quality that makes one fully human toward others; (as a noun for people) the humane
代: dài — a dynasty, an age, a period
令: lìng — fine, good (as in polite address); to command
以: yǐ — by means of, with, according to; thereby
仲: zhòng — Zhong, the courtesy name of Guan Yiwu; second-born among brothers
伯: bó — eldest, elder brother; in Meng Wubo, a name-part (武伯, 'Wu the eldest')
位: wèi — a post, a place in office, standing
何如: hé rú — how is it? what about…? (a fixed question: 'what would you say of…')
作: zuò — to start, to raise up, to make
佾: yì — a row of dancers; 八佾 'eight rows', the number due to the Son of Heaven (Zhu Xi: 佾, 舞列也)
使: shǐ — to employ, to make (someone) do
來: lái — to come; what is to come
信: xìn — good faith, being true to one's word; trustworthy; a promise given
倩: qiàn — lovely about the mouth, dimpling (Zhu Xi: 倩好口輔也)
傳: chuán — to hand on; what is handed down, the teaching received; read zhuàn 'a commentary'
傷: shāng — to hurt, to be hurt; injury (Zhu Xi: 傷者哀之過而害於和者也)
儀: yí — Yi, a town of Wei (Zhu Xi: 儀衞邑)
兄弟: xiōng dì — elder and younger brothers, brothers
先王: xiān wáng — the former kings: the sage rulers of antiquity (Yao, Shun, Yu, Wen, Wu)
先生: xiān shēng — the elders, fathers and elder brothers (Zhu Xi: 父兄); literally 'born before'
免: miǎn — to escape, to get off (Zhu Xi: 苟免刑罰, to dodge the penalties)
入: rù — to go in; at home
兩: liǎng — two, a pair (兩君 'the two rulers')
公: gōng — duke; in 哀公 a ruler's title; public, impartial (Zhu Xi: 周公而比私)
兮: xī — a song particle, a lilt at the end of a line of verse
共: gǒng — to turn toward, face (= 拱; Zhu Xi: 共音拱, 向也); read gòng 'together, to share'
其: qí — his, her, its, their; (at the head of a sentence) perhaps, surely
其諸: qí zhū — perhaps, surely (a tentative particle; Zhu Xi: 語辭)
内: nèi — inside, within, inwardly (the edition's form of 內)
冉: rǎn — Ran, a surname (Ran You, Ran Qiu)
冉有: rǎn yǒu — Ran You: the disciple Ran Qiu 冉求, then steward to the Ji house (Zhu Xi: 孔子弟子名求, 時為季氏宰)
出: chū — to go out; abroad, out in the world
利: lì — profit, gain, advantage; to find one's gain in, to profit by (利仁 'to find one's gain in humaneness')
别: bié — to tell apart, to distinguish (the edition's form of 別 bié)
加: jiā — to add; to lay upon, to put on (不使不仁者加乎其身 'lets nothing inhumane be laid on his person')
務: wù — to work at, to devote effort to
勸: quàn — to be encouraged, to be spurred on (to good)
北辰: běi chén — the North Star, the pole of the sky (Zhu Xi: 北極, 天之樞 'the pivot of heaven')
千乘: qiān shèng — a thousand chariots; 千乘之國 'a state of a thousand chariots', a major feudal state
升: shēng — to go up, to mount the steps (to the hall)
去: qù — to go away; to do away with, to remove (Zhu Xi reads this verb qǔ, 起吕反; modern practice keeps qù)
參: shēn — Shen, the personal name of Zeng Shen 曾參; also cān 'to take part in, to join', sān 'three'
友: yǒu — a friend; to befriend, to take as friend
反: fǎn — to turn back, to return; to turn over
反坫: fǎn diàn — the cup-stand: a mound between the pillars on which a ruler set back the cups after a toast (Zhu Xi: 坫在兩楹之閒, 獻酬飲畢則反爵於其上)
取: qǔ — to take, to take up, to choose
各: gè — each, every one, severally (各於其黨 'each according to his kind')
名: míng — a name; reputation, fame (成名 'to make a name')
后: hòu — sovereign, ruler (夏后氏 'the sovereign house of Xia')
君子: jūn zǐ — the gentleman; literally 'a lord's son', a man of noble birth — in the Analects, a man of cultivated character, whoever his father
告: gào — to tell, to inform; read gù 'to announce' in 告朔 (announcing the new moon)
告朔: gù shuò — announcing the new moon: the rite in which a ruler, at each month's first day, reported to the ancestral temple and put the month's calendar into force (Zhu Xi: 告朔之禮)
周: zhōu — inclusive, all-round (Zhu Xi: 普徧); Zhou, the reigning dynasty
呼: hū — alas (in 嗚呼); to call out
命: mìng — decree, command; what Heaven ordains
和: hé — harmony; ease, being relaxed and unforced; to harmonize
咎: jiù — to blame, to hold a fault against; blame
哀: āi — pity, grief; in Duke Ai, a posthumous name ('the Lamented')
哀公: āi gōng — Duke Ai of Lu, whose personal name was Jiang 蔣 (Zhu Xi: 魯君)
哉: zāi — final particle of exclamation or rhetorical question: 'how…!'
唯: wéi — only (in 唯其疾之憂 'only his illness do they worry over'); read wěi, the prompt answer 'yes' (4.15, Zhu Xi 上聲)
商: shāng — Shang, Zixia's personal name (卜商); the Shang dynasty
善: shàn — good; the good, good people; to be good at (Zhu Xi: 善兄弟曰友)
喜: xǐ — gladness, joy; to be glad
喪: sāng — mourning, funeral rites; read sàng 'to lose' (失位去國, 'to lose one's office and leave the state', Zhu Xi on 3.24)
喻: yù — to understand, to see clearly, to be versed in (Zhu Xi: 曉也)
嗚呼: wū hū — alas! (an exclamation of grief or reproach; Zhu Xi: 歎辭)
嘗: cháng — once, ever; 未嘗 'never yet'
器: qì — vessel, implement: a thing fit for one use only (Zhu Xi: 各適其用而不能相通); capacity, calibre of a man (Zhu Xi on 器小: 局量褊淺)
回: huí — Hui: the disciple Yan Hui 顏回, courtesy name Ziyuan 子淵; to turn back
因: yīn — to rely on, to depend on (Zhu Xi: 依)
固: gù — firm, solid; obstinate, blinkered (Kong Anguo's reading of 學則不固)
國: guó — a state, a feudal domain
土: tǔ — earth, land; one's native soil, home ground
在: zài — to be present, to be alive
坫: diàn — a mound of earth between the pillars of a hall for setting cups on (Zhu Xi: 坫在兩楹之閒)
堂: táng — the main hall of a house, where rites and audiences were held
塞: sè — to block, to screen off (樹塞門, a screen set at the gate); read sāi 'to stop up', sài 'a frontier pass'
士: shì — an officer, a man of service; a scholar-gentleman who aims at the Way
夏: xià — Xia, in the name Zixia; summer; the Xia, first of the Three Dynasties
夏后氏: xià hòu shì — the House of Xia: the royal line of the Xia dynasty (后 'sovereign', 氏 'house')
夕: xī — evening, dusk (朝聞道，夕死可矣)
多: duō — much, many; to hear or see much
大: dà — great, large; read tài in 大廟 'the Grand Temple' and 大師 'Grand Music-Master'
大師: tài shī — the Grand Music-Master: the chief of a court's musicians (Zhu Xi: 樂官名); 大 is read tài
大廟: tài miào — the Grand Temple: the temple of the Duke of Zhou in Lu (Zhu Xi: 魯周公廟); 大 is read tài
天下: tiān xià — all under Heaven: the world, the whole realm
天命: tiān mìng — the decree of Heaven: what Heaven charges a man or a dynasty with (Zhu Xi: the working of the heavenly Way in things)
天子: tiān zǐ — the Son of Heaven: the Zhou king, the one ruler over all the states
夫: fū — a man; in 夫子, 'that master'; read fú as an opening particle
夫子: fū zǐ — the Master: how the disciples speak of Confucius (夫 'that' + 子 'master')
夷: yí — the Yi, the peoples of the east; a 'barbarian' outside the Chinese states
夷狄: yí dí — the Yi and the Di: the 'barbarian' peoples of the east and north, outside the Chinese states
奚: xī — why? how? (question word); what? (奚取 'what is taken?', 3.2)
奥: ào — the south-west corner of a room, the place of honour (Zhu Xi: 室西南隅為奥)
女: rǔ — you (= 汝 rǔ); read nǚ 'woman, daughter'
好: hào — to be fond of, to love; read hǎo 'good'; hǎo in 兩君之好 'the friendly meeting of two rulers' (Zhu Xi: 好謂好會, and he marks it 去聲 hào)
如: rú — to be like, to come up to; as, like
如之何: rú zhī hé — how? what is to be done about it? (what to do with it)
始: shǐ — at last, for the first time; to begin
威: wēi — awe, dignity that commands respect
媚: mèi — to curry favour with, to court (Zhu Xi: 媚親順也)
子: zǐ — the Master (alone as speaker, always Confucius); a son, a child; an honorific 'Master' after a surname
子夏: zǐ xià — Zixia: the disciple Bu Shang 卜商, known for his learning in the texts
子張: zǐ zhāng — Zizhang: the disciple Zhuansun Shi 顓孫師
子游: zǐ yóu — Ziyou: the disciple Yan Yan 言偃 (Zhu Xi: 姓言名偃)
子禽: zǐ qín — Ziqin: Chen Kang 陳亢, a disciple of Confucius or (some say) of Zigong
子貢: zǐ gòng — Zigong: the disciple Duanmu Ci 端木賜, eloquent and rich from trade
孔: kǒng — Kong, Confucius' surname; very, great
孔子: kǒng zǐ — Kongzi, 'Master Kong': Confucius, so named where the book records him answering a ruler or dealing with outsiders (Zhu Xi on 孔子對曰: 尊君也, it honours the ruler)
孝: xiào — filial devotion: serving one's parents well, in life and after death
孟: mèng — Meng, the clan name (Mengsun, Zhongsun) of Lu; eldest, first
孟孫: mèng sūn — Mengsun: the Meng clan name, here for Meng Yizi (Zhu Xi: 孟孫即仲孫也)
孟懿子: mèng yì zǐ — Meng Yizi: Zhongsun He-ji 仲孫何忌, a grandee of Lu and head of the Meng (Zhongsun) house (Zhu Xi: 魯大夫仲孫氏)
孟武伯: mèng wǔ bó — Meng Wubo: Zhongsun Zhi 仲孫彘, son of Meng Yizi (Zhu Xi: 懿子之子)
季: jì — Ji, the clan name (Jisun) of the Lu house; youngest of brothers, the last of a series
季康子: jì kāng zǐ — Ji Kangzi: Jisun Fei 季孫肥, a grandee of Lu and head of the Ji house (Zhu Xi: 魯大夫季孫氏)
季氏: jì shì — the Ji: the Jisun house of Lu (Zhu Xi: 魯大夫季孫氏也)
孫: sūn — Sun, 'grandson', the clan name's last part (孟孫, 季孫, 仲孫); a grandson
學: xué — to learn; learning (by study and by imitation of those who know)
安: ān — comfort, ease; at peace; to be at ease in, content with
宋: sòng — the state of Song, where the heirs of the Yin (Shang) were enfeoffed; Song, the personal name of Duke Ding of Lu (Zhu Xi on 3.19: 定公魯君名宋)
宗: zōng — to take as chief, to look up to as head (Zhu Xi: 主); the ancestral line
官: guān — office, an official post; the officers of a household
定: dìng — Ding, posthumous name of Duke Ding of Lu; to fix, settle
定公: dìng gōng — Duke Ding of Lu, whose personal name was Song 宋 (Zhu Xi: 魯君名宋)
宰: zǎi — a steward, the chief officer of a noble house; Zai in the name Zai Wo
宰我: zǎi wǒ — Zai Wo: the disciple Zai Yu 宰予, courtesy name Ziwo, known for his sharp tongue (Zhu Xi: 孔子弟子名予)
家: jiā — a family, a house; 三家 the three great houses of Lu, Mengsun, Shusun and Jisun (Zhu Xi: 孟孫叔孫季孫之家)
寛: kuān — generous, broad-minded (the edition's form of 寬)
察: chá — to examine closely (Zhu Xi: 則又加詳矣, more minute than 觀)
寡: guǎ — few, scant; to reduce to few
寧: nìng — better, rather, preferably (寧…, 'better to…'); read níng 'peaceful'
封: fēng — a boundary, a border; the border of a district (Zhu Xi: 封疆)
封人: fēng rén — the border warden: an official in charge of a frontier district (Zhu Xi: 掌封疆之官)
射: shè — to shoot; archery, the archery contest
將: jiāng — to be about to, will; read jiàng 'a general'
對: duì — to answer, to reply (to a superior)
小人: xiǎo rén — the small man, the petty man: the gentleman's opposite; elsewhere, an ordinary person
尚: shàng — to put above, to esteem highest, to prize; still, yet
尤: yóu — fault, blame from outside (Cheng Yi, quoted by Zhu Xi: 罪自外至者也)
就: jiù — to go to, to approach
居: jū — to dwell, to live; a dwelling
已: yǐ — final particle: 'and that is all', finality; to stop
師: shī — teacher; Shi, the personal name of Zizhang (顓孫師); a multitude
庭: tíng — courtyard, the open court before a hall
康: kāng — Kang, posthumous name of Ji Kangzi; peace, well-being
廋: sōu — to hide, to conceal (Zhu Xi: 匿也)
廟: miào — an ancestral temple, a temple
弗: fú — not (it): a stronger 不, with the object 'him/it' understood
弟: tì — deference to elders, a younger brother's duty (later written 悌); read dì 'younger brother'
弟子: dì zǐ — the young (literally 'younger brothers and sons'); elsewhere, a master's disciples
張: zhāng — Zhang, in the name Zizhang; to stretch a bow
往: wǎng — to go; what has gone, the past
從: cóng — to follow, to go along with (Zhu Xi: 隨也); read zòng 'to give rein to'
御: yù — to drive (a chariot or horses); to manage, to control
復: fù — to go back over; to make good (one's word)
徵: zhēng — to prove, to bear out, to give evidence for (Zhu Xi: 徵證也); read zhǐ, a note of the five-note scale
德: dé — virtue: moral quality, the inner worth that shows in conduct
徹: chè — to clear away; to take down the vessels at the end of a sacrifice (Zhu Xi: 徹祭畢而收其俎也)
心: xīn — the heart, the mind: seat of intent and feeling
忍: rěn — to bear, to endure; to bring oneself to do (a harsh or improper thing)
志: zhì — intent, what the heart is set on
忠: zhōng — wholehearted, giving all of oneself (Zhu Xi: 盡己); later, loyalty to a ruler
思: sī — to think, thought; in the Ode line 思無邪, 'thought' (perhaps only a filler particle)
恕: shù — fellow-feeling, extending oneself to others (Zhu Xi: 推己之謂恕 'to extend oneself is called shù')
悔: huǐ — regret, remorse (Cheng Yi, quoted by Zhu Xi: 理自内出者也, what comes from within)
患: huàn — to be troubled by, to worry about
惑: huò — to be perplexed, to be led astray
惟: wéi — only; (in the Documents' quotation) a particle introducing a statement
惠: huì — a favour, kindness, a benefit bestowed
惡: è — bad, evil, poor, coarse (of food or clothes); read wù 'to hate, dislike'; read wū 'how? where?' (惡乎 'in what?')
愛: ài — to love, to cherish; to grudge, be loath to lose (Zhu Xi: 愛猶惜也)
慈: cí — kind, loving to those below (Zhu Xi: 慈於衆)
慍: yùn — to resent, to bear a smouldering grudge
憚: dàn — to dread, to shrink from
懷: huái — to keep in mind, to cherish, to long for (Zhu Xi: 思念 'to think of, to dwell on')
懼: jù — fear, to fear, to be anxious
懿: yì — Yi, posthumous name of Meng Yizi; fine, admirable
成: chéng — to accomplish; accomplished, already done (成事 'what is already done'); to complete (以成, the piece is finished)
或: huò — someone, a certain person; perhaps, whoever might
戚: qī — grief, deep sorrow (Zhu Xi: 戚則一於哀)
戰: zhàn — to fight; to tremble with fear
戰栗: zhàn lì — to tremble in fear (Zhu Xi: 戰栗恐懼貌); a pun with 栗 'chestnut'
所: suǒ — that which, where (makes a verb phrase into a noun)
指: zhǐ — to point at, to point to
掌: zhǎng — the palm of the hand
揖: yī — to bow with hands clasped, to salute with a bow
損: sǔn — to take away, to decrease
擇: zé — to choose, to pick out (a place to live, a course)
攝: shè — to hold concurrently, to double up in office (Zhu Xi: 攝兼也)
攻: gōng — to work at, to devote oneself to (Fan Zuyu, quoted by Zhu Xi: 專治也); to attack
放: fàng — to let go, to release; Fang, the personal name of Lin Fang; read fǎng 'to rely on, go by' (4.12, Zhu Xi 上聲, Kong Anguo 依也)
政: zhèng — government, the conduct of government
故: gù — the old, what is past (故者舊所聞, 'what one heard of old'); therefore
敎: jiào — to teach (the edition's form of 教 jiào); modern speech also reads jiāo for 'to teach (a skill)'
救: jiù — to save, to rescue; to prevent (Zhu Xi: 救其陷於僭竊之罪, to save him from falling into usurpation)
敬: jìng — reverent, respectful; to treat with reverent care
數: shuò — frequent, too often, repeated; also shù 'number', shǔ 'to count, to reckon'
文: wén — pattern; letters, the literary culture (the Odes, the Documents, the six arts); written records (Zhu Xi: 文典籍也); the polish of forms (郁郁乎文)
新: xīn — new, what is newly gained (Zhu Xi: 今所得)
方: fāng — a region, a quarter, a direction; a fixed destination, a known place (4.19 遊必有方)
於: yú — at, in, to, from; than (preposition)
施: shī — to extend, to spread (it) to
旅: lǚ — the lü: a sacrifice made to the mountains and rivers (Zhu Xi: 旅祭名)
易: yì — to exchange, to replace; easy; in mourning, 'smoothly ordered, managed with ease' (Zhu Xi: 易治也)
時: shí — in season, at the proper time; time and again (Zhu Xi on 時習)
書: shū — the Documents (the Book of Documents, 書經); a book, writing
曾: zēng — Zeng, a surname (read céng 'once, ever'); céng 'actually, after all' (Zhu Xi: = 嘗); zēng 'can it be that…?' (rhetorical 曾謂…乎, 3.6)
曾子: zēng zǐ — Master Zeng: the disciple Zeng Shen 曾參, one of the youngest, called 'Master' like You Ruo
有: yǒu — to have; there is, there are
有子: yǒu zǐ — Master You: the disciple You Ruo 有若, one of only two disciples the Analects calls 'Master'
有政: yǒu zhèng — the government (有 an old prefix before nouns, no meaning of its own)
朋: péng — companion, friend; Bao Xian: 同門曰朋, fellow pupils of one master
朋友: péng yǒu — friends (朋 companions of one's own kind + 友 those one befriends)
服: fú — to submit, to be won over; to take on (a task: 服其勞)
朔: shuò — the first day of the month, the new moon
朝: zhāo — morning; also cháo 'a court; to attend court'
木鐸: mù duó — the wooden-clappered bell: a bell with a metal mouth and a wooden clapper, rung to call attention to proclamations (Zhu Xi: 金口木舌, 施政教時所振以警衆者也)
杞: qǐ — the state of Qi, where the heirs of the Xia were enfeoffed (not Qi 齊; the print writes 把)
枉: wǎng — crooked, bent; the crooked, the dishonest
林: lín — a wood, a grove; Lin, the surname in Lin Fang
林放: lín fàng — Lin Fang: a man of Lu who asked Confucius about the root of the rites (Zhu Xi: 魯人)
栗: lì — chestnut; (as 慄) to shiver, to tremble
栢: bǎi — cypress (the edition's form of 柏)
格: gé — to reach, to arrive at (Zhu Xi: 至也); another view, to correct (正)
樂: lè — joyful, to take joy in; read yuè 'music', yào 'to delight in'
樊遲: fán chí — Fan Chi: the disciple Fan Xu 樊須, who drove Confucius' chariot
樹: shù — to set up, to plant; a tree
次: cì — a halt, a stopping; in 造次 'haste, hurry' (a rushed moment)
欲: yù — to want, to desire; what one wants
正: zhèng — to correct, to set straight; upright
武: wǔ — Wu, posthumous name of Meng Wubo; martial, warlike; the Wu, King Wu's music (Zhu Xi: 武王樂)
歸: guī — to return, to go home to
殆: dài — in danger, unsafe, uneasy (Zhu Xi: 危而不安; Lü Dalin: 所未安 'what one is not easy about')
殷: yīn — Yin, the Shang dynasty (so called after its late capital)
比: bǐ — partisan, to band together (Zhu Xi reads bì); to compare; to keep close to, follow (4.10 義之與比, Zhu Xi 從也)
氏: shì — clan, house (the family name as a lineage); 氏 after a surname, 'the … family'
民: mín — the people, the common folk
求: qiú — to seek, to ask for
沒: mò — to sink; to die (read méi 'not have' in modern Mandarin)
沛: pèi — abundant, flowing; in 顛沛 'toppling and overthrow'
泰山: tài shān — Mount Tai, the great mountain in Lu, to which only the ruler of Lu might sacrifice (Zhu Xi: 山名在魯地)
淫: yín — to excess, going too far; licentious
游: yóu — You, in Ziyou's name (言偃, courtesy name 子游); to roam
溫: wēn — warm, gentle (Zhu Xi: 和厚, mild and generous)
灌: guàn — to pour out a libation of fragrant wine on the ground, to call down the spirit (Zhu Xi: 灌者, 用鬱鬯之酒灌地以降神也)
為: wéi — to do, to practise; to act as, count as, be; read wèi 'for (the sake of)'; to conduct (government: 為政); to take as, count as (Zhu Xi: 以 = 為); wèi 'because' (為力不同科, 3.16)
焉: yān — in it, by them (the fused 於之); a final particle; how? where? (question word, Zhu Xi: 何也)
無: wú — not to have, without; = 毋 'do not!' (prohibitive)
然: rán — so, thus, it is so
父母: fù mǔ — father and mother, one's parents
爾: ěr — you (also in 爾愛其羊: a second-person pronoun)
犯: fàn — to offend against, to defy
狄: dí — the Di, the peoples of the north; a 'barbarian' outside the Chinese states
獲: huò — to get; to incur, to fall into (獲罪 'to incur guilt')
獻: xiàn — the worthies, wise men who remember the old ways (Zhu Xi: 獻賢也); to offer
王孫賈: wáng sūn jiǎ — Wangsun Jia: a powerful grandee of Wei (Zhu Xi: 衞大夫, 衞之權臣)
生: shēng — to grow, to be born, to arise
由: yóu — to follow, to go by; from; You, Zilu's personal name (Zhong You 仲由)
異端: yì duān — strange doctrines, a different strand: teachings other than the sages' way (Zhu Xi: 非聖人之道而别為一端)
疏: shū — distant, estranged, to be kept at a distance
疑: yí — what is doubtful, what one has not yet believed (Lü Dalin, quoted by Zhu Xi: 所未信); to doubt
發: fā — to bring out, to illuminate (Zhu Xi: 發明所言之理); to send forth
皦: jiǎo — bright, clear (Zhu Xi: 皦明也)
皮: pí — hide; the leather target, the hide stretched on a target frame (Zhu Xi: 皮革也)
盡: jìn — to the full, wholly; to exhaust, to do to the utmost
監: jiān — to oversee, to inspect; read jiàn 'to look at, to look back upon' (Zhu Xi: 監視也)
直: zhí — straight; the straight, the upright
相: xiāng — mutually, one another; read xiàng 'to assist, to attend at a rite' (Zhu Xi: 相助也), 'a minister'
盻: pàn — clear in black and white of the eye (Zhu Xi: 盻普莧反, 目黒白分也; = 盼); read xì 'to glare'
省: xǐng — to examine, to look into; read shěng 'to reduce, a province'
矣: yǐ — final particle: the situation is reached, settled — 'and so it is'
知: zhī — to know, to recognize (a person's worth); to understand; read zhì 'wise, wisdom' (later written 智; 4.1, 4.2)
矩: jǔ — carpenter's square (Zhu Xi: 法度之器, the tool of the rule); the standard
磋: cuō — to file, to rasp smooth (bone or horn)
示: shì — to show; to look at, = 視 (Zhu Xi: 示與視同)
社: shè — the altar of the soil, the shrine of the land god
祭: jì — to sacrifice to, to offer sacrifice; read zhài as a surname
禄: lù — official salary, emoluments (the edition's form of 祿 lù; Zhu Xi: 仕者之奉)
禘: dì — the di sacrifice: the great royal sacrifice to the ancestor from whom the dynasty's founder sprang (Zhao Boxun, quoted by Zhu Xi: 王者之大祭)
禮: lǐ — the rites: ceremony, ritual, the whole body of right custom and manners
禱: dǎo — to pray, to pray for blessing
禽: qín — Qin, in the name Ziqin; a bird
私: sī — private, personal; one's private life (Zhu Xi: 燕居獨處, 'at ease, alone')
科: kē — grade, class (Zhu Xi: 科等也)
穆: mù — solemn, still, reverent (in 穆穆)
穆穆: mù mù — solemn and grave, deep and still (Zhu Xi: 深遠之意, 天子之容也)
竈: zào — the stove, the hearth-god (one of the five household sacrifices)
立: lì — to stand, to be established
竭: jié — to exhaust, to use up entirely
端: duān — end, strand, a thread of teaching (一端 'one strand')
管: guǎn — Guan, a surname (Guan Zhong); a pipe, a flute
管仲: guǎn zhòng — Guan Zhong: Guan Yiwu 管夷吾, courtesy name Zhong, chief minister to Duke Huan of Qi and architect of his hegemony (Zhu Xi: 齊大夫名夷吾, 相桓公霸諸侯)
管氏: guǎn shì — the Guan house: Guan Zhong, spoken of by his clan name
節: jié — to measure, to keep within bounds (from 'a joint of bamboo')
約: yuē — straitened means, poverty, hardship; restraint, to hold in check (4.23 以約失之者鮮矣)
純: chún — pure, blended, in harmony (Zhu Xi: 純和也)
素: sù — plain white silk, the white ground on which colours are laid (Zhu Xi: 粉地畫之質也); plain
終: zhōng — the end; (here) the end of a parent's life and its rites; whole, all through (終日 'all day')
絢: xuàn — coloured pattern, decoration in colour (Zhu Xi: 采色畫之飾也)
維: wéi — (a particle that opens a clause) it is; in the Ode quoted, 'there are'
繪: huì — to paint, to draw; painting (繪事, 'the work of painting')
繹: yì — to run on, to unwind unbroken (Zhu Xi: 繹相續不絶也)
繼: jì — to succeed, to follow after (a dynasty)
罔: wǎng — lost, in the dark, bewildered (Zhu Xi: 昏而無得)
義: yì — what is right, what fits the case (Zhu Xi: 事之宜)
習: xí — to rehearse, to practise over and over (the graph has 羽 'wings': a fledgling practising flight)
翕: xī — to gather, to come together (Zhu Xi: 翕合也)
者: zhě — the one(s) who, those who: turns what precedes into a noun
而: ér — and, and then; and yet, but (links two verbs or clauses)
聞: wén — to hear, to learn of
臣: chén — a minister, a subject; a servant of a ruler
臨: lín — to approach, to preside over, to face (the people)
至: zhì — to arrive at, to reach
至於: zhì yú — as for, coming to; to the point of
致: zhì — to deliver up, to give over entirely
與: yǔ — with; to give; read yú, a final question particle (later written 歟); read yù 'to take part in' (3.12); 與其…寧… 'rather than…, better…'
舉: jǔ — to raise up, to promote (舉直 'raise the straight'); to cite (Zhu Xi: 舉大數, 'give the round number')
良: liáng — good; straightforward (Zhu Xi: 易直, easy and direct)
色: sè — colour; the face's colour, countenance; beauty, female charm
若: ruò — to be like, to equal
茍: gǒu — truly, if (Zhu Xi: 誠 'truly'); the edition's form of 苟
莊: zhuāng — gravity, dignity (Zhu Xi: 容貌端嚴也)
莫: mò — no one, none, nothing; to be unwilling, to set oneself against (4.10, Zhu Xi: 不肯也)
蓋: gài — perhaps, it may be (a word of doubt, opening a conjecture); also 'to cover'
蔽: bì — to cover, to sum up (Zhu Xi: 猶蓋也)
處: chǔ — to dwell, abide; to settle in, stay in (a condition); also chù 'a place'
衆: zhòng — the many, everyone (variant form of 眾)
行: xíng — to do, to put into practice; conduct (Zhu Xi reads the noun xìng); to work, to go
見: jiàn — to see; read xiàn 'to appear, to show oneself'
視: shì — to look at, to see what one does
親: qīn — to draw close to; those one should be close to; kin
言: yán — words, speech; to speak, to talk about
訥: nè — slow of speech, words coming with difficulty
詩: shī — the Odes (the Book of Songs, 305 ancient poems); a poem
語: yǔ — speech, words; read yù 'to tell, to instruct' (Zhu Xi: 語告也)
誨: huì — to teach, to instruct (shall I teach you…)
說: yuè — to be pleased, delighted (the word later written 悅); read shuō 'to speak, explain', shuì 'to persuade'
説: shuō — explanation, meaning (= 說 shuō); as 說, also read yuè 'pleased' and shuì 'to persuade'
請: qǐng — to request, to ask leave (請見 'ask to be presented')
諫: jiàn — to remonstrate with a superior, to admonish
諸: zhū — the fused 之於 'it to, it at'; all, the various; Zhu Xi in 2.19 glosses 諸 as 衆 'the many'
諸夏: zhū xià — the Xia states: the many Chinese states of the central plain
謀: móu — to plan, to lay plans
謂: wèi — to call (something so); to mean, to refer to; to speak of, to say of (子謂 'the Master said of…'); to say to
譬: pì — to liken, to compare; 譬如 'it is like…'
議: yì — to discuss, to deliberate (未足與議也 'not worth discussing with')
貢: gòng — Gong, in the name Zigong; tribute
貫: guàn — to string through, to run through (Zhu Xi: 通也)
賈: jiǎ — Jia, in the name Wangsun Jia; read gǔ 'merchant'
賜: cì — Ci, Zigong's personal name; to bestow
賢: xián — worthy; the worthy; to treat as worthy, to esteem
賤: jiàn — lowly, humble; low station (the opposite of 貴 'high')
起: qǐ — to rise; to stir up, to bring out (Zhu Xi: 起猶發也)
踰: yú — to overstep, to go beyond
身: shēn — body; one's own person, oneself
躬: gōng — one's own person, oneself (古者言之不出，恥躬之不逮)
車: chē — cart, carriage (大車 an ox-cart, 小車 a horse carriage; Zhu Xi)
軏: yuè — the hook on the end of a carriage-pole, where the yoke-bar for horses is fixed (Zhu Xi: 轅端上曲鉤衡以駕馬者)
輗: ní — the cross-bar on the end of an ox-cart's shaft, to which the yoke is tied (Zhu Xi: 轅端横木縛軛以駕牛者)
辟: bì — a prince, a sovereign (辟公 'the princes'; Zhu Xi: 辟公諸侯也); read pì 'to open up' (= 闢) or 'one-sided' (= 僻); as 'to avoid' (= 避) it is also read bì
辰: chén — a celestial mark: in 北辰, the pole of the sky; the fifth earthly branch
追: zhuī — to follow after, to pursue; to honour the dead with offerings
造: zào — to go to, to arrive at; to make; Zhu Xi reads cào in 造次
造次: zào cì — haste and hurry, a moment of urgency (Zhu Xi reads 造 as cào)
逮: dài — to reach, to come up to, to match
遂: suì — to go on, to proceed; under way (Zhu Xi: 遂事謂事雖未成而勢不能已者)
遊: yóu — to travel, to journey, to roam abroad
過: guò — to overstep; to err, a fault
道: dào — the Way; a way, a path; read dǎo 'to lead, to govern' (later written 導)
違: wéi — to go against, to differ from, to object (Zhu Xi: 不違者意不相背)
遠: yuǎn — far, distant; as a verb, to keep at a distance (Zhu Xi reads the verb yuàn)
適: dí — to be singly set on, to favour (4.10, Zhu Xi: 專主); read shì 'to go to'
遲: chí — Chi, from Fan Xu's courtesy name 子遲; slow, late
邪: xié — crooked, swerving, depraved; read yé as a question particle
郁: yù — rich in pattern, flourishing (Zhu Xi: 郁郁文盛貌)
郁郁: yù yù — rich and flourishing, full of pattern (Zhu Xi: 郁郁文盛貌)
鄰: lín — neighbours (five households, a neighbourhood); fellow-dwellers
鄹: zōu — Zou, a town in Lu (Zhu Xi: 魯邑名); Confucius' father was its governor
里: lǐ — a village, a neighbourhood, a ward (by the Zhou reckoning, twenty-five households); some read 里仁 as 'to dwell in humaneness'
重: zhòng — heavy, weighty; gravity of bearing; read chóng 'again, double'
錯: cuò — to set aside, to put down (Zhu Xi: 捨置也); to mix, to err
鐸: duó — a bell with a clapper, rung for proclamations (Zhu Xi: 金口木舌)
長: cháng — long, lasting; also zhǎng 'elder, senior; to grow'
門人: mén rén — disciples, the Master's pupils (門 'gate, school' + 人 'men')
閒: jiān — a space, an interval (here the edition's form of 間: 終食之閒 'the span of a meal'); also xián 'leisure'
闕: quē — to leave aside, to leave out (a gap)
關: guān — a pass, a barrier; the cry of the birds in the Ode's opening line
關雎: guān jū — the Guanju: the first poem of the Odes, the opening poem of 'Zhounan'; the name comes from its first line (Zhu Xi: 周南國風詩之首篇)
雍: yōng — the Yong: an ode of the Zhou Hymns, sung as the sacrificial vessels were cleared away (Zhu Xi: 周頌篇名); harmony
雎: jū — the osprey (in the Ode 關雎)
難: nán — hard, difficult; read nàn 'misfortune, to blame'
非: fēi — not (is not, does not belong to); to do wrong
韶: sháo — the Shao, the music of Emperor Shun (Zhu Xi: 韶舜樂)
順: shùn — compliant, in accord; to go with
顛: diān — to fall headlong, to topple, to overturn
顛沛: diān pèi — toppling and overthrow: stumbling, being thrown down, in time of upheaval
食: shí — to eat; food (read sì 'to feed')
飲: yǐn — to drink; read yìn 'to give to drink, to make drink' (3.7: the loser is made to drink)
養: yǎng — to feed, to support (Zhu Xi reads yàng 'to support one's elders')
餼: xì — a live animal for sacrifice (Zhu Xi: 餼生牲也)
饌: zhuàn — to feed, to serve a meal (Zhu Xi: 飲食之也)
鬼: guǐ — spirit of the dead, an ancestor (Zhu Xi on 非其鬼: 非其所當祭之鬼, spirits not one's to sacrifice to)
魯: lǔ — Lu, the state of Confucius, in modern Shandong
黨: dǎng — a kind, a class (Zhu Xi: 類也); also a village group, a faction
齊: qí — to make even, to bring to one standard (Zhu Xi: 所以一之也); Qi, a state
